business_overview.one_sentence: The group mainly provides private hospital services, rehabilitation and other healthcare services, haemodialysis services and elderly healthcare services in Mainland China.
business_overview.revenue_model: Medical services paid by individual patients, social insurance schemes and corporate customers; individual patients normally pay by cash/card/mobile payment, social insurance settles in 30-180 days, corporate customers normally within 90 days.
business_notes: Hospital services represented 89.4% of revenue in 2024.
Self-owned hospital revenue declined and DRG/DIP/social insurance quota pressure lowered average spending.
New haemodialysis segment contributed RMB75.8m revenue but was still loss-making.
Kangxin Hospital continued to operate at a loss and was classified as held for sale at 2024 year end.

gaps: Annual report does not disclose parent-company versus subsidiary cash split for all funds assets.
Annual report does not separate maintenance capex from growth capex. Main case uses purchases of PPE as a conservative capex deduction.
Working-capital reinvestment is assessed through cash flow movements rather than a separately disclosed normal maintenance working-capital number.
Kangxin Hospital disposal proceeds after year end are disclosed but not traced into post-disposal cash balance in the 2024 annual report.
